tokens.name: fill-light-alpha
tokens.usage: The fillLight role: a light background for ListItems and local content items or cells. Pages, bodies, columns, list organizers and large sections remain transparent. Do not nest application-authored backgrounds. Non-vibrant fallback: 15% white.

tokens.name: fill-neutral-alpha

tokens.name: fill-primary

tokens.name: fill-semilight-alpha
tokens.usage: Selected segment, chip and slider progress (fillSecondary). Also the `lightenHover` role in the color scheme, which the Button family does not draw.

tokens.name: label-darkest-alpha

tokens.name: label-light-alpha
tokens.usage: 40% white label for dim content on dark ground.

tokens.name: label-primary

tokens.name: label-primary-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on dark fills such as Button and Badge (labelPrimaryLight).

tokens.name: label-semidark-alpha
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, supporting text, unselected segment (labelTertiary): 65% black.

tokens.name: label-ultradark-alpha

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: A brief visual anchor, such as a prominent key number or essential message. Use sparingly; not for ordinary descriptions or paragraphs.

styles.name: display-medium
styles.usage: Short prominent text that anchors a page or communicates its central message. Preserve built-in component title styles.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Compact display emphasis for short important text; also the SideNavigation header default. Not a general body style.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: An important section heading that identifies a major content group. Use for short titles, not explanatory paragraphs; retain built-in dialog title styles.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: A section or module heading with a clear level below larger headings. Select by the page hierarchy; preserve component-provided titles.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: A compact section heading that separates a group of content from its body text.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: A short title for a smaller content group. Also the reference TitleBar primary title style; the Plan weight recommendation is an explicit override.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: A smaller content title. Also used by Regular Button and some window title slots; keep the specific component default rather than replacing it with Label.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Compact titles for small content groups and navigation sections.

styles.name: body-large-multiline
styles.usage: Continuous paragraphs or multi-line descriptions at the larger body size, using this variant's existing line height.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Primary body information and readable short descriptions. For continuous paragraphs, choose the existing body-large-multiline variant.

styles.name: body-medium-multiline
styles.usage: Continuous multi-line explanations or body text at the medium size, using this variant's existing line height.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Ordinary descriptions and secondary body information. Use body-medium-multiline for continuous multi-line text.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Compact supporting information such as timestamps, counts or short supplementary explanations; not a section title.

styles.name: body-tiny
styles.usage: Very compact component captions, including badge text where supported. Not the default for ordinary reading content.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Short functional text such as control labels and tags. Existing uses include Small Button and Large Chip; preserve their defaults.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Compact functional labels; existing uses include Min Button and Small Chip. Do not apply to all buttons regardless of size.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Very compact functional labels where space is limited. Prefer a larger existing text style when reading the label would otherwise be difficult.

tokens.name: gap-large
tokens.usage: Peer content blocks that need a clear separation. Also used for default button, chip and list padding where documented by the component.

tokens.name: gap-medium
tokens.usage: Different pieces of information within one content unit, or content and its adjacent action. Also used for Chip and Min Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: gap-small
tokens.usage: Related controls and buttons in one action group. Also used for compact component paddings; preserve each component's documented internal spacing.

tokens.name: padding-large
tokens.usage: Window-level inset between the shell and content. This Plan recommends start/end/bottom 32 and top 0 below a page TitleBar; do not repeat the same inset on nested wrappers.

tokens.name: padding-medium
tokens.usage: More generous inset for an application-owned content region. Also used by Regular/Max Button padding and TitleBar horizontal insets where documented; not a universal Sheet or dialog default.

tokens.name: padding-regular
tokens.usage: Standard inset for ordinary content containers and form groups. ListItem uses 16 at start/top/bottom by default; end is 4 unless explicitly overridden.

tokens.name: padding-small
tokens.usage: Compact content containers and small internal insets. Use for application-owned compact regions; existing controls retain their documented padding.

tokens.name: radius-min
tokens.usage: Very small rounded details, including slider track ends and ExtraSmall text Badge. Keep circular DotBadge and pill NumberBadge shapes unchanged.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Small marks and compact content details; Small/Regular text Badge uses this radius.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Image crops and small local content surfaces; basic Coachmark uses 8. Do not nest application-authored backgrounds. Menus use 20 for their outer shell and 12 for items.

tokens.name: radius-medium-large
tokens.usage: Small bounded content regions; TextField, Option and Menu items use 12. This is not the outer Menu radius.

tokens.name: radius-large
tokens.usage: ListItem and bounded content regions; Min Button and Min Chip also use 16. Preserve the distinct shapes of other component sizes.

tokens.name: radius-extra-large
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces such as Menu, dialog and Sheet shells. Small Button also uses 20; preserve documented component defaults.

tokens.name: radius-huge
tokens.usage: Local content shapes when the design calls for them; not permission to fill large content sections. SideNavigation items use 24. Sheet shells use 20, not 24.

tokens.name: radius-extra-huge
tokens.usage: Window contour reference and large rounded surfaces. Toolbar and TabBar also use 32; do not apply this radius to every content wrapper.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: LocalDisableAlpha: alpha applied to every disabled control.
